parameters.query:
SELECT
    id,
    student,
    subject,
    task,
    deadline,
    priority,
    DATEDIFF(deadline, CURDATE()) AS days_remaining,
    CASE
        WHEN DATEDIFF(deadline, CURDATE()) < 0 THEN 'Overdue'
        WHEN DATEDIFF(deadline, CURDATE()) <= 1 THEN 'Urgent'
        WHEN DATEDIFF(deadline, CURDATE()) <= 3 THEN 'High'
        WHEN DATEDIFF(deadline, CURDATE()) <= 7 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS urgency,
    status
FROM tasks
WHERE status = 'pending'
  AND DATEDIFF(deadline, CURDATE()) <= 1
ORDER BY days_remaining ASC;
